title: AgentArmy Image Manifest
description: Declarative spec for a platform container image deliverable. One image.json sits at the root of an image directory (templates/<name>-image/ in the hub, or a spoke repo root) and is validated + exercised by `node tools/agentarmy-doctor.mjs image <dir>`. It captures the 'rigor' of the AgentArmy Image Standard: a correct-by-default image, multi-service stacks (e.g. app + Postgres), shimmed packages, a one-command external test CLI, an external doctor that proves the image, and a deploy lane. See docs/image-standard.md.

kind.description: single = one service; app+db = an app plus a companion datastore (e.g. Postgres/ArcadeDB); multi-service = three or more cooperating services.

base.description: Primary base image, digest-pinned (image@sha256:...). For multi-service, this is the image being authored; companion services declare their own `image`.

owner.description: Where this image lives / who owns it (e.g. 'hub template', 'backend-core spoke').

services.description: The compose services that make up the deliverable. Exactly the units `setup.sh` brings up.

image.description: Pull this image (mutually exclusive with build).

build.description: Build context path (mutually exclusive with image).

role.description: Free-text role, e.g. 'api', 'dbos-system-db', 'graph-db'. Helps the doctor reason about companions.

ports.description: host:container port maps. The doctor uses the host port for http healthchecks.

entrypointModes.description: Dispatch verbs the entrypoint understands, e.g. ['serve','test','dbos'].

env.description: Non-secret env defaults for this service.

secrets.description: Secrets the stack consumes. Never values — only the wiring. Prefer *_FILE (mounted file) over a plain env var.

env.description: Plain env var that carries the value.

fileEnv.description: Preferred: env var pointing at a mounted secret file (*_FILE).

shims.description: Extra packages layered onto the base image (the 'shim onto it' lane). Keep deliberate and reviewed.

baked.description: Config/posture baked into the image so a fresh container is correct-by-default.

setup.description: The one-command external test CLI (gen secrets -> up -> wait healthy -> doctor -> wiring; --down to tear down).

doctor.description: The external verifier that proves the running image from the outside (the ArcadeDB-doctor equivalent).

cmd.description: Command/script that exits non-zero on failure, e.g. scripts/dbos-doctor.sh or `node ../../tools/agentarmy-doctor.mjs arcadedb`.

deploy.description: Cloud deploy lane for the image.

volumes.description: Named volumes that must persist together (e.g. config + data).

contract.description: Interface contracts for the APIs this image exposes (the fleet contract-first rule applied to images). Every interface-exposing service should bind to a versioned spec registered in docs/contracts.md and, where possible, a Postman mock for parallel consumers.

service.description: Which service this interface belongs to.

type.description: upstream = a vendor API we don't author; prose = a markdown contract pending formalization.

spec.description: Repo-relative path to the spec file, or a URL for an upstream/vendor API.

registry.description: Where it's registered, e.g. docs/contracts.md (the row name).

mock.description: Postman (or other) mock URL for parallel consumers.

healthcheck.description: How readiness is determined. Use http (path probed on the host port) or cmd (run inside the container).

http.description: Path or full URL probed for readiness, e.g. /health/ready.
